About Me

Focused on Systems That Scale and Don't Break.

I am a Java Backend Developer with a deep interest in backend architecture, reliable API contracts, and concurrency control.

My backend engineering journey revolves around building services that handle data safely and reliably. During my work at AetherAI, I contributed to a production vehicle-rental SaaS platform where I designed Spring Boot REST APIs, integrated payment and webhook pipelines, and resolved booking race conditions with Redis distributed locking.

I completed my B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering (Class of 2026) at IMS Engineering College, Ghaziabad. I treat backend software as an engineering discipline where API contracts must be predictable, data mutations atomic, and services thoroughly tested.

I am actively seeking full-time opportunities as a Java Backend Developer or Software Engineer where I can build impactful, high-throughput systems alongside thoughtful engineering teams.

URL-Based RAG System

A Retrieval-Augmented Generation pipeline that ingests web pages, chunks content, generates embeddings, and stores vectors in MongoDB Atlas for semantic search. Exposed REST APIs for content ingestion and querying that return answers grounded in the source pages.

Key Engineering Highlights:

  • ▸Built a Retrieval-Augmented Generation pipeline that ingests web pages, chunks content, and generates embeddings
  • ▸Stored high-dimensional vectors in MongoDB Atlas for cosine similarity semantic search
  • ▸Exposed REST APIs for content ingestion and querying that return answers grounded in the source pages
  • ▸Engineered overlapping token chunking preserving continuous semantic context across web documents
JavaSpring BootSpring AIMongoDB Atlas Vector SearchREST APIsEmbeddings
Architecture Focus

Document ingestion and semantic retrieval pipeline built with Spring AI. Web pages are ingested and split into overlapping text chunks, embedded into vector representations, and indexed in MongoDB Atlas Vector Search for low-latency cosine similarity retrieval.

Engineering Values

Core Engineering Principles

Guiding philosophies I follow when designing backend systems and collaborating in teams.

Clean & Maintainable Code

Writing self-documenting code with clear separation of concerns across controllers, services, and repositories.

Secure Authentication & AuthZ

Enforcing least-privilege role access, cryptographic token verification, and secure credential handling.

Reliable API Contracts

Designing predictable REST endpoints with standardized request/response schemas, validation, and error envelopes.

Data Consistency & Concurrency

Treating race conditions seriously using distributed locks (Redis) and transactional boundaries to prevent corruption.

Caching & Performance Awareness

Leveraging in-memory caches to protect primary databases, with conscious attention to cache invalidation and TTLs.

Automated Testing & Verification

Building automated test suites (e.g. Playwright E2E) to catch regressions before code ever hits production.

Clear Documentation & Observability

Documenting architectural decisions and utilizing structured logging for clear debugging and monitoring.
